resources.string: Tracking your location to unlock new areas.
No location fix yet — give it a moment.
World Explorer needs your location to reveal the world as you travel. Grant location permission in Settings to continue.
To keep unlocking areas while the app is closed or your screen is off, please choose Allow all the time on the next screen.
To track in the background, open Permissions → Location and switch to Allow all the time.
Keep tracking smooth on long drives
Android aggressively pauses background apps to save battery, which causes big gaps in your trail while the screen is off. Whitelisting World Explorer keeps the GPS firing reliably while you drive.
